No row — an INSTRUMENT PARK. The EXPERIENCE harness returned NO-SHEET-EFFECT ('WG encodes 1 value-bearing op(s); not on our built character: defineCastingSource CASTING_SOURCES'). AoN feat-1134 names no tradition and no spell — its whole content is the +2 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic with a trained skill — and rules-2231 sends the attribute to the source of the focus spell, so ours builds no casting source and hangs each spellmaster focus spell on the feat that prints it (feats/familiar-form.focusSpells, feats/spellmasters-ward.focusSpells). The printed clause IS delivered, as FEAT_SITUATIONAL['spellmaster-dedication'] (src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:621), and a situational star moves no number on a freshly built character — which is the whole of the harness's blindness. Owner ruled 2026-09-10 (#110) under R14. Parked in work/experience-instrument-limits.json (lane 'wg-unprinted-casting-source') with a mutation-proof pair in test/batch037-instruments-6.test.ts.

No row — an INSTRUMENT SETTLE plus a PARK, one per comparer that saw it. AoN eidolon-7 prints '**Tradition** Arcane', one word, no list; WG asks a four-branch 'Select a Tradition'. Owner ruled 2026-09-10 (#138) under R14: arcane is fixed and no picker is built. (2) the EXPERIENCE harness returned MISSING-CONTROL ('WG asks "Select a Tradition"; we render no control') — parked in work/experience-instrument-limits.json under the existing derived-value-not-a-pick lane whose precedent is battle-creed. Both mutation-proofed in test/batch037-instruments-6.test.ts, including the stunt that strips classes.summoner.subclass.options[dragon-eidolon].tradition and shows the record still reported as theirs-not-ours=[arcane]. NOTE for the closer: wg-diff still reports this record THEY-ONLY missing=[language]; that aspect is NOT this finding and nothing here settles it.
